Subject: BrightWorks redlines to Redwood MSA - feedback / training clause

Hi Neha,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Procurement + legal reviewed the MSA and attached our redlines. The primary sticking point is Section 5.c (Customer Content / Output) and an added clause in the Order Form that would allow BrightWorks to use model outputs for product development and (importantly) to train internal models unless explicitly excluded.

Our legal team also flagged that your standard feedback license is too broad for our security posture — they want a carveout so BrightWorks outputs are not used for wider productization without express consent. Can you confirm:
- Whether Redwood will accept an Order Form opt-in for training?
- If Redwood can provide a narrowly scoped feedback license limited to telemetry & safety logs (no productization rights)?

I've attached BrightWorks_Redlines_MSA.pdf with in-line comments. We're on a compressed procurement window and would like a response by EOD Wednesday 5/6 if possible.

Samir

Neha / Ben — I reviewed the attached PDF and annotated responses in the draft doc (BW_response_draft.docx). High-level recommended approach:

1) Order Form opt-in for training: Acceptable as a commercial option, BUT training consent must be explicit, time-limited, and scope-limited. Proposed language: "Customer may opt in to allow Redwood to use Customer Outputs for model training as specified in the Order Form. Any opt-in applies only to the dataset(s) and time period listed in the Order Form and may be revoked with 90 days' notice; Redwood will not use personally identifiable information or Protected Data for training without express written consent."

2) Feedback license / telemetry: Offer a narrow feedback license that covers telemetry, safety logs, and aggregate usage metrics for the purpose of improving Redwood services and safety and for detecting abuse. Explicitly exclude use of Customer Outputs for productization or resale unless separately agreed. Proposed clause: "Feedback License limited to non-identifying telemetry and safety data; excludes Output-based productization rights."

3) Output ownership: Keep existing customer output assignment for customer-provided prompts and content (Customer retains downstream rights to outputs generated from Customer Content). For outputs generated from Redwood prompts/templates or proprietary system prompts, propose shared-use language with a clear carveout for BrightWorks' proprietary data.

4) Audit/evidence: For procurement comfort, we can provide a short evidence pack (SOC-2 extract + summary of data handling) rather than changing core IP mechanics.

Commercial concession (to offer through Ben): if BrightWorks agrees to the limited feedback license and Order Form opt-in, consider offering a one-time onboarding credit or discounted overage rates for 6 months.

I attached the draft response. I can turn this into track-changes on your redlines and produce a one-page Order Form amendment. Need Ben to confirm any commercial concession we want to offer. Goal: send to Samir by EOD Wednesday 5/6.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

Samir — thanks for the redlines. Attached is our proposed compromise (Redwood_Proposed_TrackChanges.docx) with the key points summarized below: 

1) Training: We can accommodate an Order Form opt-in for training. Opt-in language is explicit and limited to the dataset(s) and time period in the Order Form; revocation available with 90 days' notice. No PII or Protected Data will be used for training without separate written consent.

2) Feedback license: We offer a narrow feedback license limited to telemetry, safety logs, and aggregated metrics used strictly for service improvement and abuse detection. The license explicitly excludes Output productization or resale without a separate written agreement.

3) Output ownership: Customer retains rights to Outputs generated from Customer Content; Redwood retains rights to system prompts and platform-derived outputs. We added a short carveout in the Order Form for BrightWorks' proprietary models/datasets when specifically listed.

4) Commercial: Ben has offered to discuss a one-time onboarding credit if BrightWorks accepts the above language and signs the Order Form within 30 days.

Please review the attached track-changes and let us know which items you want to escalate to legal redline. Happy to hop on a 30-minute call tomorrow if that helps accelerate.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
